newsitem.title: GERMANY: German draft share law -- annual reports.
newsitem.headline: German draft share law -- annual reports.

text.p: The German Justice Ministry on Tuesday released details of a new draft share law. The following is a summary of the sections of the draft referring to annual reports.
The summary was provided by the ministry in German and translated by Reuters.

* Dependency on income. To ensure the independence of auditors, an auditor will be excluded from auditing a company's accounts if it has gained more than 50 percent of its income from that company in the last five years (previously 30 percent).

* Change in auditors. If the same auditor has been commissioned by a company for many years it can create the impression of dependency. A change in the external auditing company may not appear expedient. However it is proposed that there should be a change at the level of the auditor's signing the approval after seven years. This proposal must be discussed further.
* Content of the auditors' report. Increased problem identification within the legal audit.
* Auditors' report. Increased consideration of the interests of the supervisory board in the writing of the auditors' report.
* Liability of the auditor. The liability is to be increased. A much higher sum should be set in place of the current maximum liability of 500,000 marks.
